metadata.name: Whiteout Station
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: An arctic research station packed into a snowbound hollow: a two-storey main lab and its data wing, a lab wing round a glowing core, the comms annex under its mast, the snow vehicle garage, the fuel tanks and the radar shelter up on its ridge, an ice cave in the rocks. Fight room to room, cross the yard between huts and crates, or take the tunnel under it; climb the ridge for the long look over the station.
